dialogue.text: Excuse my intrusion, but I saw the lights on and was curious.

options.text: I’ve been here since the earthquake

dialogue.text: I see. I’m sorry to say, but you won't survive by solely secluding yourself away in a “safehouse”.

options.text: I didn't know what to do...

dialogue.text: I see... You know you remind me of my daughter.
She didn’t look out for herself. She cared too much for others.
She was... gone. In an instant. She panicked and didn't know what to do.
*Sigh* I suppose I can give you a few tips on how to handle yourself.
That is if you promise to not share the same fate.
First off, you can't let the earthquake break you down.
Remember to hold on to any decent structure and find cover.
Yes, exactly. *peers down at the cards in your hand* Are those menko cards?
They are! Pay attention, I’m going to teach you the most important skills you'll need.
Look out for only yourself, and you might be able to make it out of this.
Menko’s a game where you put everything on the line.
Risk your own resources, and you'll get the chance to take your opponent’s.
Of course, losing means disastrous consequences.
But I’ll teach you my own ways. I have never been defeated - not once.

options.text: Isn’t taking resources from other people kinda…

dialogue.text: *Sigh* So naive… Go to the table and we can start a game.
